crossRefs.note: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I…
but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for…
They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you…
and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

translations.web: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
translations.bsb: “How then were your eyes opened?” they asked.
translations.kjv: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
translations.asv: They said therefore unto him, How then were thine eyes opened?
